title: Klaus und seine Bäckerei in Köln
summary: Review week 4 with Klaus, who walks you through his Saturday bakery ritual in Cologne

blocks.title: Rückblick: Woche 4
blocks.body: This week you learned the German day's three meals, how to order politely (**ich hätte gern / ich nehme**), the five **Modalverben**, the **gern**-trick for likes, and how to shop and handle **Pfand** at the supermarket. Now meet **Klaus**, an architect from Köln, who takes you along for his Saturday morning ritual.
blocks.callout: Köln statt Berlin — same German, different city, same grammar.

blocks.prompt: 'You're not allowed to smoke here.' — which is correct?
blocks.explain: *dürfen + nicht* = forbidden. Klaus would say this to explain a house rule, not *müssen*.

blocks.prompt: Type: 'I like eating cheese rolls.' (use the gern trick)
blocks.explain: *Ich esse gern Käsebrötchen.* — exactly Klaus's Saturday order.

blocks.scene: Klaus tells you about his Saturday morning ritual: the walk to his favorite Bäckerei near the Ebertplatz in Köln.

lines.speaker: Klaus
lines.target: Moin! Samstags hole ich immer Brötchen. Willst du mitkommen?
lines.en: Morning! On Saturdays I always get bread rolls. Want to come along?

lines.speaker: You
lines.en: Yes, gladly! Where are we going?

lines.speaker: Klaus
lines.target: Meine Bäckerei ist am Ebertplatz. Die ist richtig gut.
lines.en: My bakery is at the Ebertplatz. It's really good.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Was isst du normalerweise zum Frühstück?
lines.en: What do you normally eat for breakfast?

lines.speaker: Klaus
lines.target: Ich esse gern ein Käsebrötchen und trinke einen Kaffee dazu.
lines.en: I like eating a cheese roll and drinking a coffee with it.
lines.spotlight: *ich esse gern* — the gern trick, right on schedule.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Und was bestellst du dort genau?
lines.en: And what exactly do you order there?

lines.speaker: Klaus
lines.target: Ich sage einfach: Ich hätte gern zwei Käsebrötchen, bitte.
lines.en: I just say: I'd like two cheese rolls, please.

lines.speaker: You
lines.target: Und in Berlin? Ist das auch so entspannt?
lines.en: And in Berlin? Is it just as relaxed there?

lines.speaker: Klaus
lines.target: Nein, gar nicht! In Köln machen wir das entspannt — nicht so hektisch wie in Berlin.
lines.en: No, not at all! In Cologne we take it easy — not as hectic as in Berlin.
lines.spotlight: Klaus's Rhineland pride, right on cue.

questions.q: What does Klaus do every Saturday?
How does Klaus describe Cologne compared to Berlin?

blocks.prompt: Compare your own Saturday morning to Klaus's. Write 2–3 German sentences — what do you eat, and what do you like doing?
